properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued October 21 at 9:49PM PDT until October 22 at 2:00AM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northeastern Los Angeles County including the eastern San
Gabriel Mountains in southwestern California...

* WHEN...Until 200 AM PDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 947 PM PDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area.
- Rock slides and mudslides are possible.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Wrightwood, Glendora, San Dimas, Pomona, La Verne, Valyermo,
Falling Springs, Angeles Crest Highway between Mount Waterman and
Wrightwood, Angeles Crest Highway between Mount Wilson and Mount
Waterman, Azusa, Big Pines, Monrovia, Claremont, Diamond Bar and
Duarte.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

NWSheadline: FLOOD ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 2 AM PDT THURSDAY
